title: Build an evaluation runner with reproducible release artifacts
objectives: Build an evaluation runner with reproducible release artifacts
Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects build an evaluation runner with reproducible release artifacts with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. The shared local framework runs classification, retrieval, tool safety, injection, latency and cost cases over the same synthetic platform fixtures.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: An evaluation framework turns cases into reproducible evidence. A case definition names task input, expected behavior, scorer configuration and thresholds. A runner invokes the system, captures output/trace, applies reusable scorers and creates a machine-readable verdict plus a human-readable report.
Dataset version, code revision, prompt/model configuration and execution mode are part of the run identity. Without them, a comparison cannot reliably explain a regression.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Use JSON case files with unique IDs and validate them before execution. Register scorers by name, reject unknown scorers and store each score with its reason. Compute baseline deltas on matching case IDs; missing cases or crashed evaluations produce a failed/incomplete run.

Write JSON first, then generate escaped HTML from the same artifact. CI uploads reports even on failure and exits nonzero when hard gates fail or configured quality thresholds regress. Keep fixture and live reports visibly distinct.

import html
row='<script>alert(1)</script>'
assert '<script>' not in html.escape(row)

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A runner catches exceptions and reports a green average over only surviving cases. An HTML report inserts raw model output as markup, allowing script execution. A candidate is compared with a baseline from a different dataset.
Test malformed definitions, duplicate IDs, unknown scorers, provider failures, HTML escaping and nonzero exit behavior. Verify that every requested case has exactly one recorded outcome.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: The shared local framework runs classification, retrieval, tool safety, injection, latency and cost cases over the same synthetic platform fixtures. It retains failure categories and relevant evidence for triage.
Release evidence includes complete case coverage, passed hard gates and paired baseline comparison. A report is not a quality gate until its verdict actually controls the CI exit status.
